chinese: 此三者以为文不足，故令有所属﹕见素抱朴，少私寡欲。
pinyin: Jué shèng qì zhì， mín lì bǎi bèi；
Jué rén qì yì， mín fù xiào cí；
Jué qiǎo qì lì， dào zéi wú yǒu。
Cǐ sān zhě yǐ wèi wén bù zú， gù lìng yǒu suǒ shǔ ﹕ jiàn sù bào pǔ， shǎo sī guǎ yù。
english: Forget about knowledge and wisdom, and people will be a hundred times better off. Throw away charity and righteousness, and people will return to brotherly love. Throw away profit and greed, and there won't be any thieves.
These three are superficial and aren't enough to keep us at the center of the circle, so we must also:
Embrace simplicity. Put others first. Desire little.
